meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 可以帮你选择、提交和管理 Ginkgo Bioworks 云实验室的自动化实验协议，包括蛋白质表达纯化、定量、RNA 合成、热稳定性分析等，并处理定制协议的评估与报价。
howto.when: 当你说需要运行蛋白质表达、定量检测、RNA 合成、热稳定性分析、Echo-MS 或 SPR 等方法，或者提到“Ginkgo 云实验室”时触发。

say.text: 帮我用无细胞系统表达并纯化一个蛋白。
say.note: Claude 会引导选择协议和填写输入。

say.text: 提交一个 IVT mRNA 合成订单。
say.note: Claude 会帮您配置参数并生成模板。

say.text: 我想在 Ginkgo 云实验室做热稳定性分析。

howto.what_en: This skill allows Claude to help you select, submit, and manage automated lab protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab, including protein expression/purification, quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift assays, Echo-MS/SPR methods, and custom protocol estimation via EstiMate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Ginkgo Cloud Lab or express interest in running supported assays (protein expression, quantification, RNA synthesis, thermal shift, Echo-MS, SPR, pixel art, etc.) or custom workflows.

say_en.text: Help me express and purify a protein using cell-free system.
say_en.note: Claude guides protocol selection and input preparation.

say_en.text: Submit an IVT mRNA synthesis order.
say_en.note: Claude helps configure parameters and generate templates.

say_en.text: I want to run a thermal shift assay on Ginkgo Cloud Lab.
say_en.note: Claude recommends the thermal shift protocol and explains the workflow.
